lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Hello again! It is me, Gus. Today I am thinking about <color=red>dinosaurs</color>!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Five words are missing from my dinosaur lines. Fill each gap, and the library gets five new <color=red>books</color>!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
Dinosaurs lived a long, long time <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. Dinosaurs lived before us. Which word fits?
lines.correctText: Dinosaurs lived a long, long time <color=red>ago</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
Some dinosaurs were as big as a <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. Which one is very big?
lines.correctText: Some dinosaurs were as big as a <color=red>house</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
Baby dinosaurs came out of <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. Where do baby birds come from?

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
T. rex had big, sharp <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. What does an animal bite with?

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
We find dinosaur <color=red>_____</color> in rocks today.
lines.hint: Not quite. What is left of a dinosaur after a long time?
lines.correctText: We find dinosaur <color=red>bones</color> in rocks today.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: You found all five words! Five new books are off to the <color=red>library</color>!

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thank you! Some dinosaurs ate plants. I bet they loved my <color=red>cabbages</color>!
